originality.rationale: Damele 2026 proves kernel definition, projections, diagonal embeddings and tower simplicity but does not give the exact center dichotomy in its inspected 13-page full text. The published kernel-wreath abelianization note concerns a distinct invariant; the full note was not retrievable and implicit coverage remains a risk. The 2021 wreath-group-center literature covers the ambient wreath product, not the index-T balanced kernel; the exceptional C4 shows an ambient-center conclusion cannot be automatically transferred. Actual published-finding corpus searches and web searches found no explicit equivalent full statement. This is best-knowledge originality, not a uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: The published kernel-wreath abelianization note was accessible only through its abstract; it may contain an unindexed center lemma.
A stronger, earlier general theorem for centers of balanced wreath kernels might imply this statement despite not appearing in the retrieved literature.
No independent expert assessment of originality has been conducted.

value.rationale: The multiplicative center is a canonical invariant of the newly constructed infinite families of simple skew braces. The theorem gives a complete exact classification with one sharp exception, and shows persistence of a fixed center even when multiplicative group order grows from 60 to 60^(p^m); this is a structural property not determined by earlier existence or abelianization results.
